# Harry The Piano Mover

> Specialist piano mover in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Owner-operated by Harry, who is also a pianist, with an assistant on most moves. Moves upright, grand and digital pianos and pianolas across Greater Melbourne and Victoria, does interstate moves from Melbourne to Sydney and Adelaide himself, and also does piano disposal, moves within the same home, Marketplace piano deliveries and band equipment deliveries. 88 Google reviews as of October 2026. Not a general furniture removalist, and not affiliated with any similarly named removalist.

Last updated: 20 October 2026

## Services

- Piano moving: upright, grand and digital pianos, and pianolas (each pianola is quoted individually), from brand-new to new-to-you. Specialises in Japanese, Chinese and European pianos.
- Moves within the same home: for example when floors are being restored or installed, the piano is moved out of the way for a couple of weeks, then put back. A grand can sometimes stay on Harry's equipment in between, so it does not need fully setting up twice. Call or text for a quote.
- Piano disposal: pianos beyond repair are removed, with what is worth saving recycled and the rest disposed of responsibly.
- Marketplace deliveries: pianos bought on Marketplace or online collected and delivered without the buyer needing to attend the pick-up.
- Band equipment deliveries: guitars, amps, drum kits and PA taken to an event and brought back afterwards.
- Additional items can travel in the van alongside a piano.
- Piano busking: Harry's own kitsched-out acoustic grand and humble little upright, played on Melbourne's streets.

## Prices (AUD, including GST, published on the site, rates confirmed October 2026)

The zone prices are base rates, not the total for every move: steps past the included entry steps and a third person are added on top. All prices include GST.

- Inner Suburbs and CBD: upright $290, grand $530
- Outer Suburbs: upright $380, grand $630
- Outer Melbourne: upright $470, grand $720
- When a move crosses zones, the higher zone's rate applies.
- Piano disposal: upright $350, grand $460, upright pianola $870. Disposal prices include property insurance, GST and the disposal fee. Pianolas with the mechanism removed may be assessed as a standard piano depending on dimensions and access; photos and dimensions required.
- Base rates include up to 4 entry steps, or easy ramp access. Tricky access past that adds $20 per step. More than 4 steps that can't take a simple ramp need a third person, from $200.
- Beyond Outer Melbourne, and interstate, every move is a custom quote.

## How a move works

- At booking Harry confirms where the piano is going from and to, its size, brand and model, the access (stairs, narrow or difficult paths) and the preferred date.
- Floors, and anywhere the piano could come close to touching, are protected first.
- The piano is lifted onto a custom-made piano dolly, wheeled into the van and secured. For a grand, the lyre, legs, music stand and lid are removed first.
- A ramp is used for 4 or fewer steps; custom-made equipment for more than 4.
- The piano is placed where the customer wants it. Harry's advice: pianos should be kept away from outside walls and windows, but wherever you want it, pedantry included. He gives advice on the room's environmental factors and where it will look and sound best, plus long-term floor protection.
- After a move, wait three to four weeks before tuning. Harry does not tune pianos but can help find a tuner nearby.

## What to send for a quote

Text 0420 687 160 with the piano type (upright, grand, digital or pianola, plus brand and model if known), the suburb or town at each end, the preferred date, the number of steps at each end, and a photo of the piano and of any tricky access. Harry replies within a few hours.

For a disposal, send the same details with one suburb or town, where the piano is now.

## Service area

Greater Melbourne, plus Ballarat, Bendigo, Geelong, Lakes Entrance, the Mornington Peninsula and Phillip Island. Anywhere in Victoria with enough notice. Interstate: Melbourne to Sydney and Melbourne to Adelaide, done personally by Harry, by appointment only.

## Insurance

- Public liability insurance: the customer's home or property is insured during the move.
- Goods in transit (carriers) insurance: the piano is insured while it is in Harry's care and while it travels in the van.
Both are active and current.

## Contact and replies

Call or text 0420 687 160, or email info@harrythepianomover.com.au. Harry replies within a few hours.
